title: HCA normalization rewrite rule
description: Canonical, period-aware, provenance-bearing rewrite rule. The same logical record is mirrored in rules.tsv (AWK-friendly) and rules.json (full metadata).

id.description: Stable rule identifier, cited in normalization provenance and GitHub issues.

source.description: Literal historical form / substring to match. Leading/trailing spaces are significant.

confidence.description: Aggregate confidence; 1.0 for hand-curated authoritative rules.

evidence.description: Provenance: dictionary citations, issue numbers (#143), corpus refs, 'legacy:...'.

to.description: Latest year the rule applies (inclusive). Use e.g. 1872 to disable a rule after a reform.

period.description: Period of validity. null = all periods.

protect_entities.description: If true, the rule is suppressed inside spans tagged as named entities (persons/places/works).

enabled.description: Disabled rules are kept for provenance but not applied (mirrors the 7th TSV column).
